scoring: Equal-cell mean of dB ratio-of-sums NMSE; groups average three separate fit scores, not estimates. Pooled NMSE and per-fit-averaged tail quantiles are diagnostic.
primary: Three contrasts on SNR>20: EM100 bypass versus retrained model, direct EM100, compact matched-budget sparse. NMSE and BER are the six prespecified outcomes.

bootstrap.unit: Multinomial whole-anchor index; shared across all SNR/reference/methods/fits within each path regime.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on these fitted models, selected policies, compact sparse choices and condition grid; excludes training-population and selection uncertainty.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni6 intervals for high-SNR primary contrasts; all per-cell, ordinary, transition, stress and fast-bypass intervals are descriptive pointwise95.
